checkRuns.command:
pkill -f ".output/server/index.mjs"; bun run check && bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1; (PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 2
strip(){ sed 's/<!--[^>]*-->//g; s/ data-hk="[^"]*"//g' | grep -o '<main.*</main>\|<title[^>]*>[^<]*</title>'; }
for p in /about /zzz; do echo "== $p"; curl -s -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:4701$p | strip; done
echo "== POST bad"; curl -s -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST -d "name=  &email=foo@bar&message=short <b>" http://127.0.0.1:4701/contact | strip
echo "== POST bad2"; curl -s -X POST -d "name=Al&email=&message=" http://127.0.0.1:4701/contact | strip
echo "== POST good"; curl -s -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST --data-urlencode "name=  Ada  " --data-urlencode "email=ada@example.com" --data-urlencode "message=Hello there, this is a long message." http://127.0.0.1:4701/contact | strip
echo "== multipart"; curl -s -X POST -F "name=Bo" -F "email=x" -F "message=m" http://127.0.0.1:4701/contact | strip
pgrep -af "server/index.mjs"; bun run check && bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1; echo built

sed -i 's/textContent={values.message}/textContent={values.message || undefined}/' src/routes/contact.tsx && kill $(cat /tmp/srv.pid); sleep 0.5; bun run check && bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1; PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production nohup bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/srv.pid; sleep 2; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4701/contact | grep -o "<textarea[^/]*/textarea>"

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/routes/contact.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''            textContent={values.message || undefined}
''','')
s=s.replace('''            aria-describedby={describedBy("message")}
          />''','''            aria-describedby={describedBy("message")}
          >
            {isServer ? values.message : undefined}
          </textarea>''')
s=s.replace('import { createSignal, Show } from "solid-js";','import { createSignal, Show } from "solid-js";\nimport { isServer } from "solid-js/web";')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
kill $(cat /tmp/srv.pid); sleep 0.5; bun run check && bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1; PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production nohup bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/srv.pid; sleep 2; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4701/contact | grep -o "<textarea.*/textarea>"; curl -s -X POST -d "name=A&email=a&message=a<b>c" http://127.0.0.1:4701/contact | grep -o "<textarea.*/textarea>"

kill $(cat /tmp/srv.pid); sleep 0.5; bun run check && bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1; PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production nohup bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/srv.pid; sleep 2
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='.smoke3.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''if (!request.url.endsWith(".js")) { console.log("RES", response.status, request.url, request.url.includes("_server") ? await response.clone().text() : ""); return; }''','''if (request.url.includes("/_server")) { const t = await response.text(); console.log("RES", response.status, request.url, t.slice(0, 200)); return new window.Response(t, { status: response.status, headers: response.headers }); }
  if (!request.url.endsWith(".js")) return;''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
timeout 60 bun .smoke3.ts 2>&1 | grep -v "^$" | grep -v "\.css" | head -30

kill $(cat /tmp/srv.pid); sleep 0.5 printf -- '--- title: Zzz Test author: Test Author year: 1900 rating: 5 tags: [aaa] --- Hello **world**. ' > content/books/zzz-test.md bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1; PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production nohup bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/srv.pid; sleep 2 curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4701/ | grep -o "
    .*
" | sed 's///g'; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4701/books | grep -o "aaa\|Zzz Test" | sort | uniq -c; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4701/books/zzz-test | grep -o '
.*
' kill $(cat /tmp/srv.pid); rm content/books/zzz-test.md

printf -- '--- title: Zzz Test author: Test Author year: 1900 rating: 5 tags: [aaa] --- Hello **world**. ' > content/books/zzz-test.md bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1; PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production nohup bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/srv.pid; sleep 2 curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4701/ | sed 's///g; s/ data-hk="[^"]*"//g' | grep -o "
    .*
"; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4701/books/zzz-test | sed 's///g; s/ data-hk="[^"]*"//g' | grep -o '
.*' kill $(cat /tmp/srv.pid); rm content/books/zzz-test.md; git status --short

rm .smoke*.ts; bun remove happy-dom 2>&1 | tail -1; cat package.json; bun run check && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -2; PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production nohup bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/srv.pid; sleep 2
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4701/books/frankenstein | sed 's/<!--[^>]*-->//g; s/ data-hk="[^"]*"//g' | grep -o '<article.*</article>'
for p in / /books /books/frankenstein /books/nope /about /contact /nope/deep; do printf "%s %s\n" $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:4701$p) $p; done
kill $(cat /tmp/srv.pid); sleep 0.5; pgrep -af "index.mjs" | grep -v pgrep; git status --short
